title: Ripple packing for X5Ea, X5Eb, X5Na (3 each)
desc: J's 702 IMPROVEs with no note (20:56): X5Ea, X5Eb, X5Na, three variations each, with his 701 X5E note in mind ('ripples more efficiently packed onto big texture surfaces'). Each keeps its 702 colour and grading; 1 = grid, 2 = honeycomb, 3 = interference.

takes.name: X5 quantum ripple emerald - deeper - grid
takes.facts: one ripple source per block (16 per 4x4 tile instead of 1), neighbours out of step so the rings interlock; 702 X5Ea's grading: darker and more saturated (value x0.6, saturation x1.3, glow x0.7); close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: X5 quantum ripple emerald - deeper - honeycomb
takes.facts: sources on a hex lattice, about two per block, rings meeting their six neighbours along clean lines; 702 X5Ea's grading: darker and more saturated (value x0.6, saturation x1.3, glow x0.7); close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: X5 quantum ripple emerald - deeper - interference
takes.facts: seven sources per tile whose waves add up into a moving lattice over the whole surface; 702 X5Ea's grading: darker and more saturated (value x0.6, saturation x1.3, glow x0.7); close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s
